ITEM 1 | Bright orange-pink cubed fruit pieces with smooth, slightly netted rind edges, moist and firm, cut into irregular cubes about 2-3 cm, clustered in the upper part of a pale blue plate covering roughly 25% of the plate surface, stacked to about 2 cm high | 110
ITEM 2 | Caramel-brown cubed pieces with browned, slightly caramelized edges and a dry matte surface, some pieces with darker charred spots, cubes about 2-3 cm, clustered on the lower left of the plate covering roughly 20% of the plate surface, piled about 1.5-2 cm high | 90
ITEM 3 | Thin strips of cooked bacon, reddish-brown with crisp browned edges and translucent fatty streaks, slightly glossy where rendered, lying flat in overlapping strips about 1 cm wide and 10-12 cm long, covering roughly 15% of the plate at the lower right | 35
